payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures and methods used for quality evaluation on Q&A platforms, particularly focusing on Zhihu Live.

claims.text: Quality evaluation on Q&A platforms like Zhihu Live is conducted using a data-driven approach that includes data collection, cleaning, normalization, and predictive analysis.
Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) are used to estimate the performance of learning algorithms for quality evaluation.
Zhihu Live employs a reward mechanism (like up-votes) to encourage high-quality content generation, although it faces challenges with low-quality content due to insufficient filtering.
There is no unique standard for evaluating the quality of Zhihu Live responses, leading to variability in user ratings.
